text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before these errors reach the final product. This saves time and effort that would otherwise be spent fixing problems later. Beyond finding mistakes, code reviews promote knowledge sharing within a team. Developers learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase, which reduces reliance on a single person. Ultimately, this process improves overall team quality, as everyone contributes to building more reliable and maintainable software. Regular code reviews create a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
